question: Rajesh bought 5 kg of apples for Rs. 875 and sold it for Rs. 220 per kg. How much is the profit gained by him?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Selling Price (SP) of 5 kg apples = 220 × 5 = Rs. 1100

Total Cost Price (CP) of 5 kg apples = Rs. 875

Profit = Total SP − Total CP = 1100 − 875 = Rs. 225

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 225.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of 5 kg apples = Rs. 875

Selling Price (SP) of 1 kg apples = Rs. 220

**Formula Used:**

Total SP = SP per kg × Total Quantity

Profit = Total SP − Total CP

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Total CP = Rs. 875
 
 
 Total SP = Rs. 1100
 
 

 Profit = Rs. 225

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total SP of 5 kg apples = 220 × 5 = Rs. 1100

⇒ Profit = Total SP − Total CP

⇒ Profit = 1100 − 875

⇒ Profit = Rs. 225

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 225.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Percentage

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Loss Percentage

Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100

Marked Price & Discount

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) − Discount
